questions.q: What powers each chart, number, or table widget on a CRM Analytics dashboard?
options: A source report, exactly like a native dashboard
A step, which is a query against a dataset
questions.explain: CRM Analytics widgets are powered by steps that query datasets, not by source reports.

questions.q: When can a dashboard template be applied?
options: Only when the dashboard is created
Any time, to any existing dashboard
questions.explain: Templates apply only at creation. You cannot add one to an existing dashboard afterward.

options: A selection on one widget automatically filtering other widgets on the dashboard
questions.explain: Selections on chart, date, list, range, or toggle widgets filter other widgets automatically, making dashboards interactive.

questions.q: Which widget type would you use for record-level detail behind a summary?
questions.explain: Table widgets show record-level detail. Numbers show a single metric, and text widgets provide labels.

questions.q: At what level is sharing of a CRM Analytics dashboard controlled?
options: The app it is saved in
questions.explain: Dashboards are saved to apps, and access is controlled at the app level. A private app is a good place to build.
